planner_json.title: Review the evaluator workflow, capture layer, and grader contracts: secret placement, banned triggers, path confinement, aggregation order, exit-code independence, twelve-cell completeness, no root-level harness/ or branch-9624a4b gate wiring landing

write_prohibited: everything — review task writes no files

depends_on: T10 (complete twelve-cell guarantee with honest absent reasons; guard evaluates the cursor credential binding)
planner_json.dark_justification: A review task produces no observable product-surface behavior; its checks are exercised indirectly through gate steps 6-11 which fail if the reviewed contracts are broken. Only dark task: 3 of 60 points (~5%), under the 30% ceiling.

requirements.title: Review findings filed; merge-blocking contract violations resolved or named
requirements.description: GIVEN the eleven implementation tasks of sprint 01 landed on main plus one real dispatched run and its artifact WHEN the reviewer works the ten-edge checklist against the landed bytes and the artifact THEN each edge carries pass/finding/blocked with a file:line or command-output receipt and each BLOCKER is fixed-and-re-reviewed or reported unresolved

observation_gates.expected: every contract edge answered with a receipt; any fabricated-file path rejected

requirements.description: No secrets. reference in the workflow sits outside a cell model-step env block (receipt command: grep -n 'secrets\.' .github/workflows/harness-eval.yml)

The workflow declares none of the banned triggers pull_request, pull_request_target or workflow_run (receipt command: grep -Ec '^  (pull_request|pull_request_target|workflow_run):' .github/workflows/harness-eval.yml)
No root-level harness directory, no harness-matrix workflow and no branch-9624a4b gate wiring exist on main (receipt command: test ! -d harness && grep -c 'harness-matrix' scripts/release.mjs)

seed/live-dispatch-run.entrypoint: gh workflow run harness-eval --repo hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect (real dispatch, checkout default)

planner_json.agent_rationale: The review itself is performed by github-agentic-workflow-reviewer (adversarial workflow review is its specialty); a second, general code-quality reviewer audits the review's own receipts for independence.

specification.objective: Independently certify — or refuse — the evaluator's cross-task contracts before the sprint is called done.
specification.success_state: A review record in which every checklist edge has a verdict and a receipt, and every BLOCKER is either fixed by its owner and re-reviewed or explicitly named as an unresolved blocker.
